title: El Jardinero Formally Charged (Vinculado a Proceso) in Mexican Federal Court
detail: Day 72 since El Mencho's killing at Tapalpa, Jalisco (February 22, 2026). LEGAL MILESTONE — EL JARDINERO FORMALLY CHARGED: The CJNG leader known as 'El Jardinero,' arrested April 27, 2026 alongside El Güero Conta in Operation Enjambre, has been formally charged (vinculado a proceso) in Mexican federal court proceedings. This legal step — equivalent to an indictment binding the suspect to trial — marks the transition from arrest to formal prosecution in Mexico's accusatorial criminal justice system. El Jardinero had been identified as a senior CJNG operational commander; his formal charging removes another key figure from CJNG's operational structure and signals that Mexico's FGR is building a prosecutable case following the decapitation campaign. DECAPITATION CAMPAIGN — 72-DAY LEDGER: El Mencho (killed Feb 22), El Tuli (killed Feb 22), El Doble R (arrested March 11, formal charges pending), El Jardinero (arrested April 27, now formally charged), El Güero Conta (arrested April 27). The speed of formal charging — under 10 days post-arrest — reflects Mexico's accelerated federal prosecution posture under the post-Tapalpa security framework. SUCCESSION CONTEXT: El Jardinero's removal from the succession field — now formalized through federal charges — reinforces the binary El 03 vs. El Sapo dynamic identified by Mexico's Federal Security Cabinet on May 3.
